method: Survey all icons at display sizes. Measure clear frames, baselines, opposing tips and repeated-strip edges. Crop-contained pieces share their printed strip rotation. Positive angles are counterclockwise in positive-up font coordinates; preserve all artwork contours and advances on a 1/64-unit grid.

validation.geometry: Identical rigid matrices apply to all four drawings on a 1/64-unit grid. Every contour and advance retained; bounds remain inside the original em and advance box.
validation.visual_review: Every proposed rotation inspected side by side at a 192-pixel em. Local frame edges take precedence when a containing strip has slightly different page curvature. Full-detail before/after proofs retain 48, 96, 192 and 384 pixel views. Intentional slants and irregular edges remain.
